plugins.name: sensei
plugins.description: A reusable, character-swappable teaching plugin for Claude Code. Turn any project into a guided learning dojo with adaptive difficulty, spaced repetition, and rich session commands.

skills.name: challenge-me
skills.description: Generate a project-relevant exercise with acceptance criteria
skills.description_zh: 生成与当前项目相关、带验收条件的练习。

skills.name: commands
skills.description: Show available commands and their triggers
skills.description_zh: 展示可用教学命令及其触发方式。

skills.name: dojo-open
skills.description: Open a teaching session with briefing and skill pulse
skills.description_zh: 以简报和技能状态检查开启教学会话。

skills.name: notecards
skills.description: Quiz the student using spaced repetition from the Concept Index
skills.description_zh: 依据 Concept Index使用间隔重复向学习者提问。

skills.name: pizza-time
skills.description: Close the session and update progress tracking files
skills.description_zh: 结束教学会话并更新进度跟踪文件。

skills.name: progress-report
skills.description: Visual summary of mastery levels and learning progress
skills.description_zh: 可视化汇总掌握程度和学习进度。

skills.name: reset
skills.description: Re-establish Sensei teaching mode if character voice or Socratic discipline has drifted
skills.description_zh: 当角色语气或苏格拉底式教学纪律偏离时，恢复 Sensei教学模式。

skills.name: sensei-check
skills.description: Validate Sensei setup — confirms CONFIG.md, character, safeword, ROADMAP.md, and PROGRESS.md are present
skills.description_zh: 校验 Sensei配置，确认 CONFIG.md、角色、安全词、ROADMAP.md和 PROGRESS.md齐备。

skills.name: set-mode
headings: If a mode argument was provided (`$ARGUMENTS`)
skills.description_zh: 在项目过程中切换学习模式。

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Initialize sensei in the current project
headings: 1. Detect Context -- New Project vs. Existing
5. Build the Learning Foundation from Answers
Stage 4 -- Validation, Error Handling, and Edge Cases
skills.description_zh: 在当前项目初始化 Sensei。

skills.name: show-me
skills.description: Prediction-driven annotated code demo with reflection
skills.description_zh: 以先预测再演示的方式提供带注释代码示范，并引导反思。

skills.name: spar
skills.description_zh: 通过尝试、比较和差距分析循环进行刻意练习。

skills.name: teach-back
skills.description: Explain a concept back to your sensei to test your mental model
headings: What Makes This Different from /spar and /notecards
skills.description_zh: 让学习者向 Sensei复述概念，以检验心智模型。

skills.name: why
skills.description: Deep-dive into the reasoning behind a pattern or concept
skills.description_zh: 深入讲解模式或概念背后的推理。
